title: Does a pinned connect-src stop execution-capable WASM from a foreign origin, and at which layer?

edge-152.kind: branded Microsoft Edge via Playwright channel msedge

mode: headful (the headless shell cannot load extensions)

origins.note: Different ports are different origins. BOTH are in host_permissions in EVERY variant, so any difference is attributable to connect-src and not to host permissions.

requested_resource.note: BYTE-IDENTICAL from both origins; origin is the only variable.

ground_truth: Each origin keeps its own arrival log. The FOREIGN server's log is authoritative: a probe reporting 'blocked' while the server logged an arrival is a false green, and is asserted against. ext-unpinned is the positive control proving the foreign log can record arrivals at all.
known_limitations: One machine, one OS, Chromium-family only.
Loopback origins differ by PORT. A cross-host or https origin was not tested.
Neither browser is the CI binary.
